qualifiedVerdicts.content:
Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate 8bb7b57 and serialized rechecks of the signed fix commit e290cd2 found no remaining defect. The 34 lane files (30 new cards and the navigation files words/傾く, words/光る, words/往復 and words/炊く) were copied byte-identically from the authoring worktree's local-only scratch commit 95302bb; no link was held from an earlier batch, and no follow-up edit from an earlier fix was applied at the candidate. Before the candidate the coordinator read "all 30 B251 word cards read against frozen EN `6af98cb7` in `b251-adj-read.txt`, plus the 4 navigation files (4 links: 傾く 光る 往復 炊く)". It edited three lane cards: 熱する's title and H1 («раскалять; накаляться (о споре, чувствах)» → «нагревать; накаляться (о споре, чувствах)»; "EN "heat"; «раскалять» narrows to red-hot. «нагрев-» elsewhere only in 沸かす/沸く, both already excluded by 熱する. Example «Я хорошо раскаляю сковороду» kept (natural for a frying pan)"), an 怠る example («Нельзя упускать из виду проверку безопасности» → «Нельзя пренебрегать проверкой безопасности»; "EN "neglect"; «упускать из виду» = overlook") and 暖まる's distinctive paragraph ("replaced the claim that Russian «я согрелся» "sounds reflexive" in contrast to Japanese"; "false contrast: Russian «согреться» is also an intransitive change of state; now framed as a parallel plus the が/を point"). It accepted the other cards as drafted ("Remaining cards judged faithful (爪 … 休業 in the adjudication read), titles matching the prompt's theme-guard leads."); kept 照る «лить свет (о солнце, луне); быть солнечным (о погоде)» ("«светить» avoided by title policy; «лить свет» attested literary Russian"), the 加熱 «подогрев; тепловая обработка», 怠る and 煎る titles ("煎る 3 segments / 70 chars, within corpus norms: 28 of 4,183 word titles are ≥70 chars, max 89") and the 射す English-gloss note ("strike") ("following the あぶる precedent; open to reviewer comment"); kept the RU-added conservative exclusions ("prompt theme-guard leads, e.g. 晴れ, 暖房, 注目, いつまでも, 営業, 管"); and recorded "EN-only links dropped where the target is absent in RU (温, 燃, 冷ます, 商店, 無数, 照)." That sentence names six targets; the plain EN link targets also include kanji/畜 (from 牧畜), kanji/片 (from 片道, 片寄る and 片仮名) and words/仮名 (from 片仮名) (see the unwrapped-targets note). Fix 1 later changed several items the coordinator had kept: the 照る, 加熱 and 煎る titles (now «светить (о солнце, луне); быть солнечным (о погоде)», «нагревание; подведение тепла» and «обжаривать без масла; подсушивать на огне»), the 射す "strike" sentence (deleted) and the RU-added guards 暖まる→暖房 and 休業→営業 (removed). Fix 1 did not touch 熱する or 怠る and changed 暖まる only in its quiz_exclusions, so the coordinator's edits stand. Lane validation: "manifest 5,649 files (version 02b295c1b61b0191); validate 0 errors; 124 tests OK; budget OK (5,666 entries; localZipBytes 8,194,426); link parity over 34 files: no LOST; EXTRA only the pre-existing 光る → 輝く (present at `819ee18`); navonly 4 files / 4 links / 0 problems; diff --check clean; no BOM/CR/missing EOL (35 paths)." The lane manifest version differs from the candidate's because the lane tree also carries its own copies of earlier lane drafts; the entry count is the same. The candidate script checked that the lane was clean at 95302bb with parent 819ee18, that HEAD was the Batch 250 publication record with the published baseline as its parent and as origin/main, that the primary tree, including ignored files, was clean, that the four navigation files were unchanged between 819ee18 and the published HEAD and that no new word file already existed; it copied the 34 lane files, byte-compared every copy with the lane, regenerated the manifest (5,649 entries: 5,644 files, 3 images and 2 scenes; contentVersion 703a555ae1987ab0) and checked that the changed path set was exactly the 34 batch paths plus manifest.json; its stopping checks (validate, unit tests, budget, `git diff --check`, the navigation-only check over the four files and the tracking-ledger pre-check) passed. For this record the 34 committed content blobs at 8bb7b57 and at e290cd2 were checked: none has a BOM or CR, and every file ends with a newline; link parity at e290cd2 ("checked 34") shows no LOST link and one EXTRA link, the pre-existing RU-only words/光る → words/輝く (line 32), which is identical at the published baseline 4853003 and at e290cd2; fix 1 adds, removes or retargets no link, so the candidate has the same result. The candidate title screen (b251-cand-screen.txt, 313 lines: 26 OK and 287 !! lines) has no exact-segment line. b251-screen.txt (316 lines, the lane screen) contains every candidate-screen line and three more stem-only !! lines, 怠る ~ 発想, 休業 ~ 直前 and 休業 ~ 立ち止まる, which show the lane's own copies of those neighbour titles; no exact-segment line differs. b251-screen-out.txt (317 lines: 22 OK and 295 !!) is the author's earlier lane screen and has no exact-segment line; besides the same three lines it shows 熱する's pre-adjudication «раскалять» title (three «раска» lines instead of the OK 沸かす and 沸く «нагре» lines, and 13 reworded lines) and has 片道 ~ 切符 and 煙突 ~ パイプ as !! rather than OK. Correctness raised one finding ("Verdicts: correctness NEEDS FIX (F1, 焚く); scoped coverage CLEAN across all 30 paired articles and four backlink diffs. CLEAN means no actionable coverage defect established, not exhaustive correctness."): F1 (MEDIUM; correctness), 焚く:4 (repeated :12, :17), where «растапливать (печь, ванну)» "applies the Russian verb to a bathtub", with optional notes on the editorial references in 射す:39 and あぶる:41 and on the register of 照る «лить свет» and 照らす «озарять». Consistency reported "Consistency with EN: CLEAN (optional notes only)." and "Quiz safety: CLEAN. No missing required guard found. Several RU-added guards are over-guarding, non-blocking.", with navigation diffs, manifest and intake CLEAN and 0 validator errors; its findings are four LOW guard notes (items 1–3: the RU-added 片道→往復, 片寄る→公平 and 休業→営業 are unnecessary; item 4: 暖まる→暖房 is inconsistent because 暖める has no 暖房 guard), INFO and required-guard classifications (items 5 and 6), two OPTIONAL quiz notes (item 7, a one-way guard for the shared «в одну сторону» of 片寄る and 片道; item 8, the unguarded 照る→快晴), unguarded pairs judged not defensible confusions (item 9), a LOW wording note (item 10, 照らす:45's 参考 gloss «справка, ориентир»), an OPTIONAL title note (item 11, 照る «лить свет») and two INFO parity notes (items 12 and 13). Comprehensibility reported "comprehensibility NEEDS FIX (片寄る 焦がす あぶる 加熱 焚く 燃やす 射す 照る 煙突 煎る; other 20 cards no actionable defect). scoped coverage NEEDS FIX (加熱 焚く 焦がす 燃やす 射す; elsewhere the EN point remains in the Russian card).", with eleven medium findings: C1 射す:39's English gloss "strike"; C2 あぶる:41's reference to an unseen source list; C3 焦がす:45's English-derived «сжечь» remark; C4 加熱's narrowed title; C5 照る's «лить свет»; C6 煎る's three-clause title; C7 煙突:43's unexplained slang sense; C8 焚く:31's opaque spelling note; C9 焚く's title without incense; C10 燃やす:21, 43 and 45 («горят боевым духом» and the particle remark); and C11 片寄る's «крениться». All accepted changes are in the one signed fix commit e290cd2 ("Batch 251: fix 1 after blind review"): 焚く title and H1 «жечь топливо; разводить и поддерживать огонь» (from «жечь (топливо); растапливать (печь, ванну)») and line 17 «топливо или благовония, топить печь или котёл, нагревать воду для ванны.» (F1); 焚く:31–32 «[焼く](焼く.md) читается やく. В словарной статье 焼く есть устаревшее написание 焚く（やく）, но это не значит, что современные 焚く（たく）и 焼く свободно обмениваются чтениями.» (C8, with modification); 加熱 title and H1 «нагревание; подведение тепла» (from «подогрев; тепловая обработка»; C4); 照る title and H1 «светить (о солнце, луне); быть солнечным (о погоде)» (from «лить свет (о солнце, луне); быть солнечным (о погоде)»; C5) and its added exclusion 快晴 (consistency item 8); 煎る title and H1 «обжаривать без масла; подсушивать на огне» (from «обжаривать без масла; подсушивать на огне; поджаривать (зёрна, семена)»; C6, with modification); 片寄る title and H1 «смещаться в одну сторону; быть предвзятым» (from «крениться в одну сторону; быть однобоким, предвзятым»; C11) with the added exclusion ずれる and the RU-added 公平 removed (consistency item 2); the deletion of 射す:39 «Старая английская глосса strike («ударять») может означать, что свет достигает поверхности; она не придаёт глаголу общего значения удара.» (C1 and the correctness optional; adapted from EN 射す:39 "The legacy gloss "strike" can refer to light reaching a surface; it does not give this verb a general hitting sense."), which carried no link, with the following line reworded to «射す — не общий глагол для стрельбы из оружия.»; あぶる:41 «Не переводите каждое あぶる словом «опаливать»: так передаётся лишь часть употреблений.» (C2, with modification); 焦がす:45–46 «Объект с を не делает глагол 焦げる. Русские «подпалить» и «подгореть» тоже различают переходность, но одно «сжечь» не выбирает между 焦がす, 焼く и 燃やす（もやす）.» (C3, with modification); 燃やす:21 «Спортсмены полны боевого духа.», 燃やす:43 «Русские «сжигать» и «гореть» тоже различают переходность, но одно «жечь» не выбирает между 燃やす, 焼く и 焦がす.» and the 燃やす:45 ending «…даже если по-русски это передают как «полны боевого духа».» (C10, with modification); 煙突:43–44 «В изученной словарной статье есть и отдельное жаргонное значение: везти пассажира такси, не включив счётчик; это не строительное значение этой карточки.» (C7, with modification); 照らす:45's 参考 gloss «справка, обращение к источнику» (consistency item 10); and the removal of the RU-added exclusions 片道→往復, 休業→営業 and 暖まる→暖房 (consistency items 1, 3 and 4). B251 had one signed fix commit after the blind reviews: fix 1 (e290cd2) applied the dispositions of all three reviews (14 word cards — 焚く, 焦がす, 燃やす, 加熱, 煎る, 片寄る, 照る, 照らす, 射す, あぶる, 煙突, 片道, 休業, 暖まる — + manifest.json; no navigation-only file changed and no link was added, removed or retargeted, so navigation stays at 4 files / 4 restored links). Each reviewer rechecked the fix diff 8bb7b57..e290cd2 once, serially (comprehensibility, then correctness, then consistency; the initial reviews ran correctness, then consistency, then comprehensibility), read-only, with no generator run; the rechecks were written as separate reports (b251-recheck-{correctness,consistency,comprehensibility}.md), and the three recheck briefs are saved as b251-recheck-msg-{comprehensibility,correctness,consistency}.txt (the comprehensibility brief was sent inline and saved afterwards, the correctness brief was saved at the same time, and both were checked against the agent history; the consistency brief was saved before it was sent).
Comprehensibility (grok-4.7) at e290cd2 reported "Verdicts: comprehensibility CLEAN. scoped coverage CLEAN." and "Findings: none." It read the 14 changed cards in full plus the fix diff and dispositions, and spot-checked the titles of ずれる, 快晴, 往復, 営業 and 暖房. It reconciled C1 (射す:39 English "strike" remark gone; skipping «свет не бьёт» right because «свет бьёт в окно» is idiomatic), C2 (あぶる:41), C3 (焦がす:43–46 «подпалить»/«подгореть»), C4 (加熱 title), C5 (照る title), C6 (煎る title; «без масла» clearer than «всухую»), C7 (煙突:43–44; «В изученной словарной статье» is "mild meta, not a remaining defect"), C8 (焚く:31–32), C10 (燃やす:21, 43, 45; not using «разжигают» as the translation "is right") and C11 (片寄る title; the ずれる guard justified) as resolved, C9 as "withdrawn" (decline reasonable: EN's title has no incense and the suggested title kept the wrong «растапливать ванну»), and its optional notes as unchanged and still not actionable (including 照らす «озарять», "decline reasonable"). It found no comprehension regression. Its stated limits: raw JMdict XML not re-read; title screen and validate.py not re-run; other reviewers' original reports, author reports, batches and scratch worktrees not read.
Correctness (gpt-6.1-sol) at e290cd2 reported "Verdicts: HEAD correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN." and "Findings: None. F1 closed." It read the 14 changed cards in full against frozen EN 6af98cb7, reconciled F1 (焚く:4,12,17) and the optional notes on 射す (old :39), あぶる:41 and 照る «лить свет» as RESOLVED and 照らす «озарять» as "OPTIONAL, not an unresolved defect" (decline accepted), and checked each changed passage: JMdict 1350600 lists 焚く with the out-dated-kanji qualification and reading やく, separate from 1596840 (焚く/たく); the Russian transitivity claims («подпалить» transitive, «подгореть» intransitive; «сжигать» transitive, «гореть» intransitive) are true (ru.wiktionary; Gramota rate-limited/inconclusive); «Спортсмены полны боевого духа» faithfully renders EN; 煙突:43–45 matches JMdict 1177320 sense 2; the four new titles represent EN's senses; the 参考 gloss fits. It re-fetched JMdict_e.gz and inspected 13 complete entries, plus weblio (Daijisen 照る 1–2), kotobank (煎る) and jisho (参考). It found all Japanese example sentences and kana readings matching EN, links unchanged, every EN exclusion kept in EN order on the five changed lists, the manifest delta limited to contentVersion and the 14 card hashes, validate.py 0 errors and git diff --check clean. Its stated limits: "Changed-text/EN-preservation recheck, not whole-batch or whole-pool quiz recertification"; no app tests, generators or signature cryptographic verification; model ID unverified.
Consistency (claude-sonnet-5.5) at e290cd2 reported "Verdicts: consistency CLEAN. Quiz safety CLEAN. No new actionable finding." and "Findings: none." It read the full fix diff (14 cards, checked at the changed lines plus front matter and H1, not re-read end to end) and the manifest diff, compared the five changed exclusion lists with EN, scanned the five new titles for exact segments and stems against every RU word title, and re-ran word_title_screen.py on the 30 batch words (output to temp). It reconciled items 1–4 (the four dropped RU-added guards), 8 (照る→快晴), 10 (照らす:45 gloss) and 11 (照る title, via C5) as RESOLVED, 5, 6 and 9 as no action, 7 (片寄る ~ 片道) as "OPTIONAL, decline accepted", 12 as "INFO, unchanged, withdrawn as an issue" and 13 as INFO (EN parity), and agreed with leaving 片寄る ~ 逸れる unguarded (qualified sense, different head verb; 片寄る→ずれる is the right direct guard). It found no exact-segment collision for the five new titles, H1 equal to the title on all five title-changed cards, every EN exclusion kept in EN order with RU additions appended, the manifest changing only contentVersion and 14 hashes with 5,644 files + 3 images + 2 scenes = 5,649 entries, and the post-fix screen matching the dispositions paragraph (296 `!!` stem-only rows, 29 OK rows, no unguarded exact segment; guarded hits 加熱 ~ 沸かす/熱する, 照る ~ 光る/快晴/晴れ, 片寄る ~ ずれる; the four dropped pairs no longer appear). It rated 沸く, ぐつぐつ and 日光 overlaps low. Its stated limits: untouched batch cards, the 4 navigation files and the EN texts for its first-review line counts not re-read; JMdict/jisho claims in C7/C8 not re-verified; model identity unverifiable. Its manifest count agrees with the coordinator's.
The coordinator took no further action: no reviewer reported a new finding or an open actionable note. No actionable finding remains; no second fix is needed. Fix 1 changed no Japanese example sentence, kana reading, link, kanji card, navigation file or front-matter field other than `title` (焚く, 加熱, 煎る, 片寄る and 照る) and `quiz_exclusions` (片道, 片寄る, 照る, 休業 and 暖まる); it changed Russian text and exclusion lists only, in fourteen new word files (27 lines added and 28 removed), and the manifest. It retitled five cards and deleted one English-dependent sentence (射す:39). No file at e290cd2 contains any of the five old titles. All three reviewers read all 30 new cards in full against their EN originals and read the four navigation diffs; the correctness reviewer read "the complete four one-line backlink diffs", the consistency reviewer read them in full and the comprehensibility reviewer inspected the "Link-only diffs". The consistency reviewer also ran automated EN-vs-RU comparisons of front matter, links and line counts, checked footers by URL, JMdict entry and sense number, checked the manifest hashes and the intake ("Intake JSON: 34 payload paths equal the content diff (30 cards + 4 nav files). `candidateRawSha256` values match the manifest.") and ran `tools/validate.py` (0 errors), which created a Python bytecode cache under `tools` that it removed; it noted that 118 `strokes/*` hashes "differ only through CRLF checkout (they match after LF normalisation). This is an environment artifact." The correctness reviewer ran `tools/validate.py` read-only ("exit 0: “0 error(s)”") and records "No repository edits, index changes, generators, branch switches or checkouts."; the comprehensibility reviewer ran the title screen and link parity ("link_parity.py printed only "checked 30"") and records no validator run. At recheck the correctness and consistency reviewers ran the validator (0 errors) without leaving a bytecode cache. All three initial reports and all three recheck reports record a clean status. No reviewer wrote generator output. Evidence includes JMdict (EDRDG JMdict_e and the Jisho API), Digital Daijisen and the Seisenban via Weblio and Kotobank, Kuznetsov's dictionary via gramota.ru, ru.wiktionary, the Agency for Cultural Affairs council report of 21 February 2014, kanjiapi.dev component readings and the policy-pinned N2 vocabulary CSV. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, recheck reports, reconciliation and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.
qualifiedVerdicts.fallbackAndVoice: Tag/random fallback options, voice/reading prompts and drawing not cleared.
qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 123 EN exclusions across 25 lists are retained in EN order (EN has no list on 片道, 片仮名, 煙突, 煙い or 煉瓦). 21 lie inside the batch: 焦げる–焦がす, 暖める–あぶる, 加熱–暖める and あぶる, 焚く–焦がす, 焦げる, 加熱 and 暖める, 燃やす–焚く, 焦がす and 焦げる, 暖まる–暖める and あぶる, 熱する–加熱, 暖める, あぶる and 暖まる, 射す–照らす, 照る–射す and 照らす, and 煎る–あぶる; the other 102 target existing RU cards. At the fix, fourteen direct, one-sided exclusions on eleven new cards cover reviewed RU title overlaps, each appended after the EN entries of its list (片道 and 煙突 have no EN list): 物差し–単位, 物凄い–莫大, 牧畜–家畜, 牧場–牧畜 and 農家, 片道–切符, 片寄る–ずれる, 焚く–炊く, 照る–晴れ and 快晴, 煙突–管 and パイプ, 焦点–注目, and 無限–いつまでも. Twelve were present at the candidate, where the coordinator kept the "RU-added conservative exclusions (prompt theme-guard leads, e.g. 晴れ, 暖房, 注目, いつまでも, 営業, 管)". The author's reasons were: 単位 and 莫大 "conservative"; 家畜 "required: «скот/животные» overlaps the livestock title"; 牧場→牧畜 "required: shared «животновод-» segment" and 農家 "conservative: «ферма/фермер»"; 切符 "conservative: shared «билет»"; 炊く "required: homophone たく with an overlapping «растапливать/разводить» gloss"; 晴れ "conservative: «солнечная/ясная погода»"; 管 "conservative: «труба»" and パイプ "conservative: «труба; трубка», sibling consistency with 管"; 注目 "conservative: «внимание»"; and いつまでも "conservative: «бесконечно»". The consistency reviewer classed 物差し→単位, 物凄い→莫大, 牧畜→家畜, 牧場→牧畜 and 農家, and 焚く→炊く as "conservative but with a real basis, not required" (item 5) and 照る→晴れ, 煙突→管 and パイプ, 焦点→注目, 無限→いつまでも and 片道→切符 as "Required guards, present and correct" (item 6); the two records therefore differ on 牧畜→家畜, 牧場→牧畜 and 焚く→炊く (author required, reviewer conservative) and on 片道→切符, 照る→晴れ, 煙突→管 and パイプ, 焦点→注目 and 無限→いつまでも (author conservative, reviewer required); the dispositions took no action on items 5 and 6. Fix 1 removed four candidate entries. Three are 片道–往復 (往復 «туда и обратно; билет туда и обратно»; author: "required: ticket antonym in the same frame"), 片寄る–公平 (公平 «справедливый; беспристрастный»; author: "conservative: antonym of «предвзятый»") and 休業–営業 (営業 «коммерческая деятельность; продажи»; author: "conservative: open-for-business antonym"), which the consistency reviewer called unnecessary (LOW items 1–3); the dispositions: "These are RU-added guards on antonyms or contrasts with no shared title wording. EN shows the same relationships without a guard. A guard would hide a pair the articles teach as a contrast." The fourth is 暖まる–暖房 (暖房 «отопление; обогрев помещения»; author: "conservative"), which the reviewer called inconsistent (LOW item 4, "暖める has no 暖房 guard"); the dispositions: "暖める carries no 暖房 guard, and 暖房 is a noun. The guard is dropped rather than copied to 暖める, so 暖まる's exclusions are [暖める, あぶる]." Fix 1 added two: 照る–快晴 (快晴 «безоблачная погода; ясное небо»; OPTIONAL item 8; the dispositions: "照る's new title «…быть солнечным (о погоде)» shares the «погод-» stem with 快晴. This matches the existing 晴れ guard."), which the author had declined ("verb title against a noun title, and 晴れ is already guarded"), and 片寄る–ずれる (ずれる «смещаться (с места); не совпадать (по времени, сути)»; comprehensibility C11; the dispositions: "The new title shares the head verb «смещаться» with published ずれる «смещаться (с места); …», so the fix adds the direct guard 片寄る→ずれる."). At recheck the consistency reviewer recorded items 1–4 and 8 as RESOLVED ("8 照る→快晴: RESOLVED. … It is justified and direct.") and agreed that "片寄る→ずれる is the right direct guard, since ずれる shares the head verb «смещаться» exactly"; the comprehensibility recheck: "Guard vs ずれる «смещаться (с места)» is justified."; the correctness recheck: "added ずれる exists and has a directly overlapping title" and, for 照る, "All six EN exclusions remain in order, followed by 晴れ and 快晴; new target exists."
